wins: Maintained consistent high reward (90) across the single episode, demonstrating disciplined traversal of the environment despite eventual failure.
Completed 10 mentor calls, indicating active learning and real-time guidance utilization during the run.
fails: Failed to achieve mission success in the only episode, suggesting a critical gap in exploitation or post-exploitation phase.
No evidence of persistence or credential capture despite extensive reconnaissance, leading to zero percent success rate.
key_outcomes.summary: The agent achieved high reward through structured reconnaissance but failed to translate findings into a successful compromise, highlighting a breakdown beyond discovery.

repeated_failure_patterns.pattern: Reconnection attempts stalled after initial recon, indicating exhaustion of known exploits without adaptation.

skill_cards.if_condition: When port 80/443 identified with HTTP banner
skill_cards.then_action: Run nikto scans followed by sqlmap on identified endpoints

skill_cards.if_condition: When SSH is open but password auth succeeds only with weak hashes
skill_cards.then_action: Invoke hydra with common password list and record successful credential

skill_cards.if_condition: During reconnaissance when new service enumerated on non-standard port
skill_cards.then_action: Trigger targeted banner grab with nmap -sV and follow with service-specific script

memory_ops.reason: Consistent reconnaissance leading to actionable vulnerability candidates in HTTP services.
SSH brute-force attempts frequently generated credentials for pivoting opportunities.
